title: Optimal Pruning for Neural Architectures using Fisher Information Distances
description:
arXiv:2609.16129v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: A new scheme for parameter pruning is introduced, derived from the differential-geometric distance in model space. Pruning a parameter sets its value to zero, representing a displacement of the model to the hypersurface on which that parameter vanishes.
